name: video_montage
character: a cut-heavy montage: many short shots, so the hit budget and the grid are relaxed with a written reason; sync stays strict

video.hit_density.reason: a montage cuts every second or two; a 24/min budget would force the cue to ignore the edit

video.grid_phase.reason: a montage's cut spacing is not metronomic; half a frame of accumulated drift is expected

video.shot_scale.reason: a montage changes shot scale inside a section, so a per-section density cap measures the edit, not the score
